finding: Browser-visible audio output route selection is an independent evidence layer. A fulfilled route-selection operation and matching sink identifier support route binding, but do not prove continuing device availability, acoustic emission, or human audibility.
uncertainty: Browser implementation support differs by API surface and browser version.
A stored sink identifier can remain after the physical device becomes unavailable.
The validator establishes browser-observed routing state only.
falsification_routes: Cause a mismatched requested and observed sink to validate.
Cause a selected sink absent from enumerateDevices evidence to validate.
Retain a non-empty device label without rejection.
Derive physical output or human audibility from route binding alone.

verification.environment: isolated Node.js runtime using byte-identical file contents
